title: DWARF debug-info reconstruction
preconditions: ELF/Mach-O with DWARF or a matching debug file
steps: `readelf --debug-dump=info` and `readelf --debug-dump=decodedline` (or `dwarfdump`) to map addresses to source lines.
Use `gdb` `ptype`, `info line *ADDR`, and `pahole` to confirm layouts and padding.
Feed the recovered types back into Ghidra/rizin before writing an exploit or parser.
falsifier: No `.debug_*` sections and no matching debug file; DWARF cannot help.
